paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: GPT-3 demonstrated that extremely large autoregressive language models can be used for few-shot predictions, where the model is given a natural language task description and optionally a handful of exemplars.

evidence.quote: GPT-3 (Brown et al., 2020) demonstrated that extremely large autoregressive language models (LMs) can be used for few-shot predictions, where the model is only given a natural language task description and (optionally) a handful of exemplars demonstrating how the task should be completed.
